props.gloss_en: all vessels are taken on Shabbat, and their doors with them, even though they came apart on Shabbat
for they are not like the doors of the house, because those are not from what is prepared
a person may take a mallet to crack nuts with it
an axe -- to cut a fig-cake with it
a saw -- to saw cheese with it
a spade -- to scoop dried figs with it
a winnowing shovel and a pitchfork -- to put [food] on it for a child
a spindle and a shuttle -- to stick [food] with it
a hand needle -- to take out a thorn with it
and a sack-makers' [needle] -- to open the door with it
Abaye: this is what it says -- all vessels are taken on Shabbat with their doors; even though they came apart on a weekday, they are taken on Shabbat
the door of a chest, of a box, and of a cupboard -- one removes it but does not replace it
and of a chicken coop -- one neither removes nor replaces
since it is attached to the ground -- there is building in the ground, there is dismantling in the ground
Abaye: actually he holds there is building in vessels and there is dismantling in vessels
Abaye: and it says 'those that were removed' [are not replaced]
Rava: he holds there is no building in vessels and no dismantling in vessels
Rava: and [not replacing] is a decree lest he fasten it

objections.gloss_en: 'even though they came apart on Shabbat' -- and need it not say on a weekday? אדרבה: on Shabbat they were prepared on their parent [vessel], on a weekday they were not (122b.8)

answered_by.gloss_en: Abaye, הכי קאמר: even though they came apart on a weekday, they are taken on Shabbat (= p_abaye_nitparku_bechol)

objections.gloss_en: but the chest, box and cupboard -- what does he hold? If there is building in vessels, there is dismantling; if there is no dismantling, there is no building (122b.12)

answered_by.gloss_en: Abaye: he holds there is building and dismantling in vessels, and it says 'those that were removed' (= p_abaye_yesh_binyan_bekelim, p_abaye_shenitlu_kaamar; refuted at 122b.14)
Rava: no building and no dismantling in vessels, and a decree lest he fasten it (= p_rava_ein_binyan_bekelim, p_rava_gzeira_shema_yitka)

objections.gloss_en: Rava to him: two refutations -- one, it teaches 'they remove'; and further, what is 'but they do not replace'?
